title: PNP: No major threats ahead of Trump’s visit for Asean Summit
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) said it has not detected any major security threats ahead of United States President Donald Trump’s arrival for the 49th Asean Summit.…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) said it has not detected any major security threats ahead of United States President Donald Trump’s arrival for the 49th Asean Summit. “No major threats na namo-monitor. But of course, we are monitoring and constantly surveying yung situation,” PNP spokesperson Brig. Gen. Allen Rae Co said in a press briefing on Tuesday. (No major threats have been monitored so far. But of course, we are monitoring and constantly surveying the situation.) “We have security arrangements in place,” added Co.
